import sys, struct, plistlib, base64
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dev'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from harness import *
from protocols import adb_packet, get_value_request

ok = True
L = lease('home', '2001:db8:1:1200::/56', 0, 100, (0,), 2)
T1 = '2001:db8:1:1200::1'
T2 = '2001:db8:1:1200::2'
EX = '2001:db8:1:1200::9'
CN = adb_packet(0x4e584e43, 0x01020304, 5, b'host::x')

def snap(rows, services, queries=(10,), leases=None):
    got, _ = run(campaign(leases or [L], services, list(queries), [make_capture(rows)]))
    return got['snapshots'][0]

# tcp open on internal target, witness <= event
S = {'web': 'tcp'}
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'web', 0, '')]
s = snap(rows, S)
ok &= check('tcp open internal', s['leases'][0]['services'][0], {
    'id': 'web', 'internal_open': [T1], 'internal_closed': [], 'external_open': [],
    'external_closed': [], 'internal_only': [], 'protocol_errors': 0})
ok &= check('unbound 0', s['unbound_applications'], 0)

# causality: event before witness -> unbound
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 2, T1, 'open', 'web', 0, '')]
s = snap(rows, S)
ok &= check('causality unbound', s['unbound_applications'], 1)
ok &= check('causality no status', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'], [])

# max attempt wins
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'web', 0, ''),
        app('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'closed', 'web', 1, '')]
s = snap(rows, S)
ok &= check('max attempt closed', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_closed'], [T1])
ok &= check('max attempt not open', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'], [])

# disagreement at max attempt -> unknown, no protocol error
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'web', 3, ''),
        app('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'closed', 'web', 3, '')]
s = snap(rows, S)
ok &= check('mixed unknown', (s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'],
                              s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_closed']), ([], []))

# timeout at max attempt -> unknown
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'web', 0, ''),
        app('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'timeout', 'web', 1, '')]
s = snap(rows, S)
ok &= check('timeout unknown', (s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'],
                                 s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_closed']), ([], []))

# external target eligible, internal_only when every E closed
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        icmp('j', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i2', T2, EX, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'web', 0, ''),
        app('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, EX, 'closed', 'web', 0, '')]
s = snap(rows, S)
ok &= check('internal_only satisfied', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_only'], [T1])
ok &= check('external closed', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['external_closed'], [EX])

# E nonempty but one E address unknown -> internal_only empty
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        icmp('j', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i2', T2, EX, 'echo'),
        icmp('k', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, '2001:db8:1:1200::8', 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'web', 0, ''),
        app('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, EX, 'closed', 'web', 0, '')]
s = snap(rows, S)
ok &= check('internal_only blocked', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_only'], [])

# E empty -> internal_only empty
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'web', 0, '')]
s = snap(rows, S)
ok &= check('internal_only empty E', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_only'], [])

# adb protocol error at latest attempt
A = {'dev': 'adb'}
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'dev', 0, b64(CN)),
        app('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'dev', 1, b64(b'garbage'))]
s = snap(rows, A)
ok &= check('adb protocol error', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['protocol_errors'], 1)
ok &= check('adb unknown', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'], [])

# adb valid open
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'dev', 0, b64(CN))]
s = snap(rows, A)
ok &= check('adb open', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'], [T1])

# identical signatures across identities agree
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'dev', 0, b64(CN)),
        app('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 5, T1, 'open', 'dev', 0, b64(CN))]
s = snap(rows, A)
ok &= check('adb agree', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'], [T1])

# differing arg1 does not affect CNXN signature
CN2 = adb_packet(0x4e584e43, 0x01020304, 99, b'host::x')
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'dev', 0, b64(CN)),
        app('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 5, T1, 'open', 'dev', 0, b64(CN2))]
s = snap(rows, A)
ok &= check('CNXN arg1 ignored', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'], [T1])

# AUTH vs CNXN disagree
AU = adb_packet(0x48545541, 1, 2, b'abc')
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'dev', 0, b64(CN)),
        app('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 5, T1, 'open', 'dev', 0, b64(AU))]
s = snap(rows, A)
ok &= check('AUTH vs CNXN', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'], [])

# protocol error on earlier attempt only -> none
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'dev', 0, b64(b'garbage')),
        app('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'dev', 1, b64(CN))]
s = snap(rows, A)
ok &= check('earlier attempt no error', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['protocol_errors'], 0)
ok &= check('earlier attempt open', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'], [T1])

# sync service
Y = {'sync': 'sync'}
frame = get_value_request('ProductVersion') + get_value_request('ProductName')
good = b64(frame)
wrong = b64(get_value_request('ProductName') + get_value_request('ProductVersion'))
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'sync', 0, good)]
s = snap(rows, Y)
ok &= check('sync open', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'], [T1])
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'sync', 0, wrong)]
s = snap(rows, Y)
ok &= check('sync wrong order unknown', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'], [])
ok &= check('sync wrong order error', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['protocol_errors'], 1)

# unbound rows for quarantined / inactive leases
rows = [icmp('c', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/c', '2001:db8:1:1200:e22c:bc0:ce5b:ffd',
             '2001:db8:1:1200:e22c:bc0:ce5b:ffd', 'echo'),
        app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'web', 0, '')]
s = snap(rows, S)
ok &= check('alias app unbound', s['unbound_applications'], 1)
Lin = lease('in', '2001:db8:2::/64', 0, 5)
rows = [app('a', 0, 4, 'put', 'in', 1, '2001:db8:2::1', 'open', 'web', 0, '')]
s = snap(rows, S, leases=[Lin])
ok &= check('inactive app unbound', s['unbound_applications'], 1)
ok &= check('inactive app service', s['leases'][0]['services'][0]['internal_open'], [])

print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAILURES')
PYEOF
